fusions.name: Unhurried Stampede
fusions.desc: A stamp that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance of [Stalled] for 6 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Whole Herd Leaning
fusions.desc: A shove that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 60% chance of [Enervated] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Shared Sunpatch
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Chewed Over
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
